svg.aria-label: JouleWise: a pre-registered, blinded instrument for the energy of local LLM inference
svg.title: JouleWise: a pre-registered, blinded instrument for the energy of local LLM inference
svg.text: What a laptop’s power counters can resolve
An open instrument for measuring the energy of language-model inference on a laptop.
Before asking how much energy each phase of a request uses, it asks how finely the laptop’s
own sensors can divide energy between phases at all, and what limits that.
Machine: Apple M3 Max, 128 GB, MLX on the GPU
